# ERYTHRASMA

Erythrasma presents as brownish-red, well circumscribed, irregularly shaped patches in or near skin folds. Patches in the groin often itch. Most cases respond to topical therapy.

## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Sanford keyword: erythrasma
Up-to-date website
Holdiness MR Drugs 2002, 62:1131
Therapy:
## Inpatient/Outpatient

Clindamycin 1% topical solution apply twice daily [M] for 14 days
